deviations.justification: refine-beads declares only work-graph.graph-health as its optional work-graph capability (TRD-029 capabilities block), whose default template is `bv --robot-insights`; the separate `bv --robot-plan` collection and rerun are not a declared capability. (TRD-029 names insights/alerts/suggest explicitly; robot-plan is implied by the declared capability set.)
TRD-029 replaces `bv --robot-insights/--robot-alerts/--robot-suggest` with the single optional work-graph.graph-health, whose default template is `bv --robot-insights`.

Pre-refactor repair mutations (`br update`, `br dep remove`) appeared only inside prohibition/approval prose, not as steps; the refactor lists them as the supported tracker.update / tracker.dep-remove calls of the generic `run <capability>` repair loop (TRD-029 AC: repair plan entries name tracker.* capabilities).
See tracker.update: the repair loop now names tracker.dep-remove explicitly; default beads template is `br dep remove`.

The supported-mutation list in the repair loop is now written in capability order (tracker.comment, tracker.update, tracker.dep-add, tracker.dep-remove) instead of the pre-refactor prose order (dep add before comments add); repair plan entries are applied one approved fix at a time in plan order, so first-mention order within that list is not an execution order.
